description: Leave a condition on a recorded signal, or on a wallet health factor, and let this always-on server check it every 5 minutes ($0.010 USDC, up to 168h). Use when you will not be running at the moment it matters. Pass webhook= (signed POST) or ntfy= (push topic) to be woken when it fires; /watch/status?wallet=&token= stays free. For a wallet use signal=wallet-health&subject=<address>&op=below&threshold=1.3. Not for reading a value now.

ntfy.description: ntfy.sh topic, 12-64 characters, that receives a push when the watch fires

payment.description: Optional. Base64 x402 payment payload you signed yourself (ERC-3009 TransferWithAuthorization, USDC on Base). Call without it once to receive the payment requirements, sign those, then call again with this argument. This server forwards the payload and never holds a key.

webhook.description: public https URL that receives a signed POST when the watch fires

name: watch_condition
